definitions.explanation: Having a surface without bumps, curves, or protrusions. Physically flat or level.
Expressed in simple, straightforward terms without complexity or jargon.

examples.japanese: {平|ひら}たい⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}って→拾う：00845_hirou⟧⟦{水切|みずき}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I picked up a flat stone and skipped it across the water.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平|ひら}たい⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This region has a lot of flat land.

examples.japanese: {平|ひら}たい⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{載|の}せた→載せる：28290_noseru⟧。
examples.english: I placed the cake on a flat plate.

examples.japanese: {平|ひら}たく⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧だった⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧ことだ。
examples.english: To put it plainly, it was a failure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{平|ひら}たく⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you explain it in plain terms without using difficult words?

examples.japanese: {平|ひら}たく⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧ことです。
examples.english: To put it simply, we don't have enough money.

notes:
- {平|ひら}たい → {平|ひら}たく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (negative)
- {平|ひら}たい → {平|ひら}たく (adverbial form)
- {平|ひら}たい → {平|ひら}たかった (past)

USAGE:
Sense 1 describes physical flatness:
- {平|ひら}たい⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧ (flat plate)
- {平|ひら}たい⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧ (flat roof)
- {平|ひら}たい⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (flat face)

Sense 2 is used in the expression {平|ひら}たく⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to put it simply/plainly).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平|たい}ら→平ら：03399_taira⟧ - Flat, level (more formal/literary)
- ⟦{平坦|へいたん}→平坦：12475_heitan⟧ - Flat, even (often for terrain)
- フラット - Flat (loanword, often for musical pitch or design)
